sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Vehicle preparation, restraint use and traffic-stop procedure
Every knowledge statement for Vehicle preparation, restraint use and traffic-stop procedure is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
The child-restraint legal thresholds and front-seat exceptions are withheld pending review. The reproduced car-seat recommendations remain recommendations, and manufacturer fit limits are not converted into a different legal rule. Broad traffic-stop rights claims are separately withheld.
Maintenance and ordinary stop-procedure facts are page-bound. Ambiguous equipment generalizations, fixed impact-force examples, historical study numbers and current service contacts are excluded from the stable fact set.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PREPARATION-CHILD-LEGAL): The child-seat legal list joins age and weight with AND, and its later belt and front-seat clauses include manufacturer limits and unreproduced statutory exceptions. Exact threshold logic and current applicability require legal review before instructional rules are minted.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PREPARATION-STOP-RIGHTS): The traffic-stop rights passage makes broad claims about information duties, passenger compliance, searches, detention duration and access to counsel. These legal claims are withheld pending qualified review and current statutory verification.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PREPARATION-TIRE): The tire-pressure passage lists both the vehicle manual and tire sidewall without distinguishing recommended inflation from a tire rating. Do not teach a sidewall value as universally recommended pressure.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PREPARATION-AIRBAG): The airbag discussion uses broad side-impact, rear-impact and rollover wording after describing frontal impacts. Do not generalize this as the capability of every airbag system; equipment-specific guidance needs verification.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PREPARATION-IMPACT): The load example asserts a fixed impact force from mass and road speed without stating stopping time or distance. That numerical example and the similar bracing analogy are not minted as physical facts.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PREPARATION-VISUAL): Seat, restraint and steering illustrations have not been visually checked. Image-dependent fit, position or maneuver practice needs source-image validation.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
